message: repl: Show feedback when copying REPL output (#64276) # Objective The copy button on REPL output provides no visual confirmation after copying. I noticed this when copying Python REPL output: it was unclear whether the click had worked. ## Solution Show a green checkmark and a “Copied!” popup below and to the right of the copy button after copying. The feedback disappears after two seconds, and clicking again restarts the timer. Each output maintains its own feedback state. The change is limited to REPL output controls; the shared CopyButton component is unchanged. ## Testing The following checks passed on macOS: - `cargo check -p repl --offline --locked` - Rust formatting checks - `git diff --check` Manually tested on macOS: - Copying REPL output puts the expected content on the clipboard. - A green checkmark and a “Copied!” popup appear beside the copy button. - The feedback disappears after two seconds. - Clicking again restarts the timer. - Copy feedback is independent for each output. Manual verification steps: 1. Run `cargo run` and open a Python file with an available REPL kernel. 2. Execute `print("Copy feedback test")` and click the output's copy button. 3. Confirm that a green checkmark and a “Copied!” popup appear immediately, with the popup below and to the right of the button. 4. Paste the clipboard contents and confirm that they match the output. 5. Confirm that the feedback disappears after two seconds and repeated clicks restart the timer. 6. Run multiple outputs and confirm that copying one does not change another output's feedback. ## Self-Review Checklist: - [x] I've reviewed my own diff for quality, security, and reliability - [x] Unsafe blocks (if any) have justifying comments - [x] The content adheres to Zed's UI standards ([UX/UI](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#uiux-checklist) and [icon](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/blob/main/crates/icons/README.md) guidelines) - [x] Tests cover the new/changed behavior - [x] Performance impact has been considered and is acceptable ## Showcase --- Release Notes: - Fixed missing visual feedback when copying REPL output. --------- Co-authored-by: dino
